# Built documents

This directory contains independent generated documents, not the PLAER engine.

- [Basics](basics/index.html): a definition, a statement, and its separate proof file.
- [Fermat](fermat/index.html): two statements with independent proof files.

Download this repository before opening an HTML document. Each output directory
also includes the original statement source, proof snapshots, exact runnable
Lean checker files, audit records, and build provenance.

Build a chosen project with `python scripts/build.py --project <project.json>`.
